title: Case 019: New Buildings Sum Insured
initial_request: I would like a quotation to increase the buildings sum insured for my home at 119 Maple Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 1ZZ, from £360,000 to £420,000. Please treat this as a request for terms only; I am not authorising a change to my policy.
overview: Zoe asked Will Mercer at Briarfield Risk to obtain terms for increasing her buildings sum insured from £360,000 to £420,000. Will requested a recalculation from Northmere Mutual and clarified that Zoe had not authorised an amendment. The insurer provided conditional revised terms, which Will passed to Zoe; she confirmed receipt without instructing the broker to proceed.

next_action.summary: If Zoe wants to pursue the increase, request a recalculation from Northmere Mutual for the requested £420,000 sum without treating the request as authority to amend the policy.

outcome: A recalculation proposal was received and passed on to Zoe; the buildings sum insured remains unchanged.

events.body: Please obtain a quotation to increase the buildings sum insured for my home at 119 Maple Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 1ZZ, from £360,000 to £420,000. This is only a request for terms, not permission to change my policy.

Please recalculate the terms on Zoe Clark’s current policy for a buildings sum insured of £420,000, compared with the current £360,000. Zoe is seeking a quotation only and has not authorised an amendment.

We can review the requested sum, but please confirm that £420,000 is the figure to use and that no change is to be made unless the policyholder later gives instructions. We will then provide the recalculated terms.
Confirmed: please calculate terms using a buildings sum insured of £420,000. This remains a quotation request only, with no instruction to amend the policy.

The recalculated terms show an additional premium of £57.60, including Insurance Premium Tax, for the remaining policy period at a £420,000 buildings sum insured. These terms are subject to final underwriting checks and do not alter the current policy; cover remains based on £360,000 unless an amendment is subsequently requested and confirmed.

Northmere Mutual has returned terms for the requested £420,000 buildings sum insured: an additional £57.60, including Insurance Premium Tax, for the remaining policy period, subject to final underwriting checks. I have passed the proposal on for your consideration; your current sum remains £360,000 unless an amendment is later requested and confirmed.
Thank you, I have received the quotation and will review it. I am not asking you to make a change to the policy at this stage.
